gameName: Agatha Christie: Death on the Cards
aliases: Agatha Christie's Death on the Cards
firstPlayerRule: The player whose birthday is closest to September 15, Agatha Christie's birthday, starts the game.
officialTieBreak: Flip a coin if players are tied.
clarifications: Players take turns clockwise. The rulebook says the two-player and five-to-six-player versions use the same starting rule.

internalEvidence: The Modiphius product page links this Shopify-hosted publisher PDF as its rules. Rendered foldout page 1, Set-Up step 6, selects the birthday closest to Agatha Christie's September 15 birthday, calls for a coin flip on a tie, and establishes clockwise turns. Page 2 says the two-player and five-to-six-player versions use the same rules except their listed changes; neither changes the starter.
